Claire —

Thanks for flagging. Quick clarifying questions so we send the right paperwork:

- Is the invoice being paid from Zenith Biotech US, or from an EU-registered subsidiary (same legal entity name but different VAT/EIN)?
- If the payor is a US entity, we can provide a completed W-9 (Redwood Inference, Inc., EIN: 12-3456789). If the payor is an EU entity and the invoice is billed from an EU subsidiary, Redwood would need to provide a W-8BEN-E (foreign entity) and you would not issue a 1099 — instead VAT/withholding rules may apply.
- Please confirm the remit name exactly as it appears on the invoice and the remit address for wire beneficiary verification.

Marissa — looping you in to confirm internal 1099 policy and whether we should just send a W-9 to accelerate this payment, or ask for the payor to provide a statement proving US source of payment.

I can attach a signed W-9 if that’s the immediate need or we can initiate W-8BEN-E paperwork if Zenith confirms EU disbursement.

Best,

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.co le@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 04 Oct 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Zenith AP ask (1099 applicability)

Naomi — quick note (internal):

If Zenith is paying from their US entity, we issue W-9 and no withholding; 1099 will be generated per usual calendar if payment is to owner-occupied US entity. If payment originates from an EU subsidiary, 1099 should not be issued to a foreign entity — we should obtain W-8BEN-E and certificate of tax residence if they request relief for any withholding.

Recommend: send the W-9 now to avoid hold, but mark the vendor record to expect a potential switch to W-8BEN-E if Zenith confirms non-US payer. Also request VAT certificate and remit address to validate wire beneficiary.

Marissa
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 07 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -07:00

Claire —

Thanks for the quick turn and attachments. We reviewed the files and here are next steps so payment can proceed without tax/regulatory hiccups: 

1) W-9: we received the signed W-9 (Zenith_W9_signed.pdf). That resolves vendor onboarding for US tax reporting. Please confirm the remit beneficiary name exactly matches our vendor record: "Redwood Inference, Inc." (case and punctuation preferred).

2) EU-funded wire: because Zenith treasury is sending the wire from an EU account, please confirm whether the payment is classified as US-source or foreign-source income for your treasury records. If it’s foreign-source, we do not expect a 1099 and you can supply a brief statement of payor residency for our records.

3) If Zenith prefers to keep the EU treasury routing (and wants to avoid any ambiguity), we can accept the W-9 for now and you can also provide the W-8BEN-E for the payee entity that receives funds — that combination is unusual but acceptable for tracking. Otherwise, provide the W-8BEN-E and certificate of tax residence for the EU treasury entity.

4) Wire instructions: we will only run the wire once we have DocuSign confirmation of the bank details. Please send the DocuSign link for Wire-Instructions.xlsx (we did not process the spreadsheet attachment for security reasons). You can also confirm bank account last four digits in the body to expedite internal verification.

Proposed payment schedule: payment queued for 2026-10-12 pending DocuSign and beneficiary name confirmation. If you want an earlier release we can expedite with manager approval.

Best regards,
